content.title: What hand signals do cyclists use for turning?
content.summary: Left turn: cyclists should extend their left hand straight out from their side to indicate a left turn. Right turn: cyclists should raise their left hand in a 90 degree angle or extend their right hand straight out from their side to indicate a right turn.

faqs.q: What hand signals do cyclists use for turning?
faqs.a: Left turn: cyclists should extend their left hand straight out from their side to indicate a left turn. Right turn: cyclists should raise their left hand in a 90 degree angle or extend their right hand straight out from their side to indicate a right turn.
